scenarios.observable: Every accepted finding has a requirement, every final requirement has implementation and evaluation, and reverse links are symmetric.
Material disagreement is represented as a conflict and finalization is blocked until resolved or explicitly left non-final.
A substantive target change without a requirement is rejected or removed rather than retroactively justified.
The final report distinguishes corpus-bounded trace coverage from completeness of external knowledge.
Frozen evaluator expectations are not modified to make the candidate pass.
